test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is NOT a necessary characteristic of a kite?

options.text: At least one diagonal is bisected by the other diagonal.
The diagonals are perpendicular to each other.
The pairs of opposite angles are bisected by the corresponding diagonals.
At least one pair of opposite angles is congruent.

solution:
**Properties of a kite:**

• Diagonals are perpendicular

• One diagonal bisects the other

• One pair of opposite angles is congruent

• Only one diagonal bisects angles (not both pairs)

**Calculation / Reasoning:**

⇒ A kite has only **one axis of symmetry**

⇒ Only **one pair** of opposite angles is bisected

⇒ Both pairs of opposite angles are **not** bisected by diagonals

**∴ The correct answer is:**

**The pairs of opposite angles are bisected by the corresponding diagonals.**
